basis: What the privacy report and the published local-only audits show (docs: security/privacy-report). src/__tests__/privacyLabels.test.ts keeps this file in step with the privacy ledger's categories and with the published audits.

default.summary: With the default settings (no cloud key, no sync provider, no crash-reporting key in the build) nothing leaves the device: the local-only audit shows 0 non-local requests.

dataTypes.condition: Only in a build made with a crash-reporting key (VITE_SENTRY_DSN), and only until the user opts out (Settings). Personal data is scrubbed before sending (src/lib/telemetry.ts).

apple.note: Everything under optionalFeatures is sent by the user's own choice to the service the user set up (their own key or account); the developer receives none of it.

google.userCanRequestDeletion: Nothing is held by the developer; all data is on the device.

conditionalCollection.type: App info and performance: Crash logs
conditionalCollection.condition: Only in a build made with a crash-reporting key (VITE_SENTRY_DSN), and only until the user opts out.

optionalFeatures.feature: Cloud AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral)
optionalFeatures.sends: The text you send to the AI
optionalFeatures.turnedOnBy: Your own API key and the cloud or local-first AI policy; refused under local-only
A policy other than local-only; refused under local-only
Running a research command with a research service configured; refused under local-only
Opening a canvas in a production build; refused under local-only

optionalFeatures.feature: Model and dictionary downloads (Hugging Face, GitHub)
optionalFeatures.turnedOnBy: Choosing a local model or a dictionary

optionalFeatures.sends: Whatever that request carries; listed so an audit can compare

optionalFeatures.feature: Encrypted sync (WebDAV, S3, Dropbox, Google Drive)
optionalFeatures.sends: Ciphertext only, to the storage you chose
End-to-end encrypted edits, to your collaborators (and a collab server, if configured)
